_comment: Example client config for answer_engine.py --client-config. Only simple UPPER_SNAKE placeholder keys (no spaces/commas in the template token) are substituted automatically -- anything else in a template (e.g. {{N, e.g., Okta}}) is a free-text note for a human to fill in by hand, and will show up in the output's unresolved_placeholders column regardless of this file.
